title: ctenitis crystallina
intro: Ctenitis crystallina, commonly known as the crystal fern, is a type of plant species found in tropical regions. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis crystallina include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
